replies.hub.title: Auto replies
replies.hub.sub: When someone comments or DMs you a keyword on Instagram, we reply and send them the link in a DM by ourselves.
replies.needWorker: Auto replies need the Scout Worker and your Instagram account connected in Settings.
replies.needPermission: We need Instagram's permission to reply to comments and send messages.
replies.status.slow: Checking every 5 minutes today (free storage limit)
replies.deleteBody: We will stop answering these keywords.
replies.form.target.message: DMs you or replies to a story
replies.form.noPosts: No synced posts yet; sync Instagram from Growth.
replies.form.keywordsHint: Separate them with commas. Diacritics, capitals and emoji don't matter.
replies.form.publicHint: One is picked at random each time. Write {username} to mention the commenter.
replies.form.publicSuggested: Sent you the link in a DM 🎬
replies.form.dmHint: Buttons open your links and count the taps. If Instagram refuses buttons in the first message, the links go as lines under it.
replies.rules.title: Active auto replies
replies.empty: No auto replies yet. Add the first one: the word “لت” on the LUT post, for example.
replies.tester.title: Try a word
replies.tester.placeholder: Type a test comment or message…
replies.log.title: Recent replies
replies.problem.keywordTooLong: That keyword is too long ({max} characters at most).
replies.problem.dmTooLong: The message is longer than Instagram allows (about 1,000 English letters, 500 Arabic, with the links).
replies.problem.templateTooLong: With buttons, the message must be {max} characters or fewer.
replies.problem.publicTooLong: The public reply is too long ({max} characters at most).
replies.problem.noPost: Pick the post from the grid.
replies.err.notConnected: Instagram is not connected; connect it in Settings.
replies.err.noPermission: No permission to reply; press “Allow auto-replies”.
replies.err.rateLimited: Instagram asked us to slow down; we continue on the next check.
replies.err.notEligible: Instagram takes no private reply to this comment (older than 7 days, already answered privately, deleted, or the account blocks message requests).
replies.notice.scanRequested: Check requested; replies go out within a minute.
replies.notice.paused: Replies are paused; switch them back on to check.
replies.notice.guard: Today's free storage limit is reached; checks resume after 03:00.
replies.default.title: Default reply
replies.default.hint: When someone DMs you without any of your keywords. Once a day per person; never for story replies, emoji-only messages, or chats you're answering yourself.
replies.default.suggested: Got your message 🙏 I'll reply as soon as I can.
